name: VIP
displayDescription:
Unlock daily coin rewards and exclusive VIP perks.
Includes a bright yellow VIP skin, a VIP chat tag, and a crown cosmetic to show off your status.

name: Rainbow Skin
displayDescription: Rainbow Skin changes your ape's skin to a cool rainbow effect, making you stand out from the other apes!

name: Infinite Speed Boost
displayDescription:
Unlock a permanent 1.2x speed boost that is active at all times. 
Fully stacks with all shop speed boosts for even greater speed.

name: Advanced Radar
displayDescription:
Upgrade your Radar with a larger detection range and a proximity beep when monsters get closer.
Applies every time you purchase a Radar for stronger tracking and awareness.

name: Survival Kit
displayDescription:
Receive one random shop item every time you respawn.
Includes items such as a Speed Potion, Sonar, and Flashlight to help you survive longer.

name: Extra Item Capacity
displayDescription:
Doubles the max limit of all shop items.
Carry twice as many items of Speed Potions, Noise Makers, and more at once.
